name: The Morrow Stone
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: The moment the artifact is removed from the Monolith, you feel the energy in the Stave of Equinex begin to fade.
narrative.objectives: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I have been reading since you left, adventurer. This stone you have found is called the Morrow Stone. While I am not entirely sure what its purpose is yet, you can be sure that it is something of great significance to be hidden away inside the Equinex Monolith the way it was.

I will continue my studies, and I hope I will be able to count on you in the future, adventurer. Thank you for all your help.
narrative.requestItemsText: I am glad you have returned, adventurer. I am eager to hear of your findings.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 47 to 50, 19,040 XP in all.

quests.name: In Search of Knowledge
quests.objectiveText: Talk to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Feralas: A History
quests.objectiveText: Ask Daryn Lightwind if you may borrow her book.

quests.name: The Borrower
quests.objectiveText: Take the letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Super Snapper FX
quests.objectiveText: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Return to Troyas
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the book to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Stave of Equinex
quests.objectiveText: Energize Troyas' Stave and find the Equinex Monolith.

quests.name: The Morrow Stone
quests.objectiveText: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
